name: EcoRAG
description: EcoRAG is a multi-hop economic question answering benchmark built on knowledge graphs, designed to evaluate retrieval-augmented generation models with extended reasoning depth up to seven hops and complex subgraph structures in the economic domain.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the EcoRAG paper that is not yet widely established as a standard leaderboard in the broader NLP community.
notes: Focuses on bridging structured knowledge sources and generative models with complex multi-hop retrieval and reasoning in economics.
